allow: PowerShell(git rev-parse --show-toplevel; "---files in repo---"; git ls-files | Select-Object -First 20; "---count---"; \(git ls-files | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines)
PowerShell($g = Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "gh: $\($g.Source\)"; gh auth status } else { "gh not installed" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3311" -UseBasicParsing; "status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $h = $r.Content; "TiniLand title present: $\($h -match 'TiniLand'\)"; "SKIP btn present: $\($h -match 'SKIP'\)"; "castle svg present: $\($h -match 'viewBox=.0 0 400 260'\)"; "intro bg present: $\($h -match 'from-night-900'\)"; "EntryGate button present: $\($h -match 'Enter the Kingdom'\)")

PowerShell($v = Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($v\) { "vercel: $\($v.Source\)"; vercel --version } else { "vercel CLI not installed" }; "---token in env?---"; if \($env:VERCEL_TOKEN\) { "VERCEL_TOKEN set" } else { "VERCEL_TOKEN not set" }; "---auth file?---"; Test-Path "$env:APPDATA\\com.vercel.cli\\auth.json")
